# Gesture Volume: Smart On-Screen Volume Slider for Android (Official Gumroad Release)

--- ### ⚠️ The Problem: Fragile Hardware in a Touch-First World Physical volume rockers on modern smartphones and tablets take a beating. Over months and years of daily usage—watching YouTube, scrolling TikTok, listening to Spotify, gaming, or adjusting audio during calls—these mechanical buttons wear out, lose their click, get physically stuck, or stop registering touches altogether. When a physical volume button dies, Android users face two painful choices: 1. **Expensive Hardware Repairs ($40 – $100):** Repairing a volume flex cable usually requires heat guns, ungluing delicate OLED panels, and replacing frame assemblies—often voiding water resistance seals. 2. **Clunky Assistive Apps:** Most third-party volume apps dump permanent, screen-blocking floating bubbles right over your content, cause accidental taps during gameplay, and run background polling loops that drain battery. That is why I created **Gesture Volume**. --- ## ✨ What is Gesture Volume? **Gesture Volume** is an ultra-lightweight, modern Android system utility designed specifically for devices with broken, worn-out, or hard-to-reach physical volume buttons. Instead of floating bubbles or intrusive overlays, Gesture Volume places an unobtrusive, **frosted translucent pill handle** tucked quietly against the edge of your screen. In its idle state, it occupies a tiny 1/3 footprint (~7dp width). The moment you touch it, it smoothly expands into an interactive volume slider: * **👆 Swipe UP:** Instantly raise media volume. * **👇 Swipe DOWN:** Instantly lower media volume. * **💨 Auto-Dismiss:** Once released, it gracefully fades away after 2.5 seconds back into zero CPU activity. It works seamlessly over every application—fullscreen games, Netflix, YouTube, TikTok, and phone calls. --- ## 🛒 The Gumroad Launch: Direct, DRM-Free Standalone Package Today, Gesture Volume is officially available on **Gumroad** as a direct, DRM-free release package for anyone who wants quick, hassle-free installation without relying on big app stores or vendor locks. * 🛒 **Direct Purchase Link:** [https://khalidabdullahh.gumroad.com/l/ebwxyg](https://khalidabdullahh.gumroad.com/l/ebwxyg) * 💵 **Price:** $0.99 (One-time, lifetime access & updates) * 📦 **Deliverable:** Signed release APK (`GestureVolume-v1.0.1.apk`, 1.1 MB) + Setup Guide --- ## 🚀 Key Features & Capabilities ### 1. Compact 1/3 Idle Handle Tucked against your screen bezel, the handle remains virtually invisible during everyday browsing. It only reveals itself when you deliberately interact with it. ### 2. Full Edge & Position Customization Every device and hand size is different. Gesture Volume gives you complete geometric control: * **Left or Right Edge:** Match your dominant hand or device orientation. * **Snap Presets:** Instant positioning at Top, Upper-Mid, Center, Lower-Mid, or Bottom. * **Fine-Tuning:** Continuous vertical slider adjustment from 10% to 90% of screen height. * **Opacity & Sensitivity:** Adjust idle opacity from 10% (nearly transparent) to 100%, and customize swipe sensitivity per volume step. ### 3. Modern Material 3 Dark HUD Whenever volume changes, a sleek, minimalist overlay appears showing the exact volume percentage and audio stream icon, with customizable positioning (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, or Right). ### 4. Tactile Haptic Acoustics Adjusting volume feels tangible. Gesture Volume sends crisp, linear resonant actuator (LRA) vibration pulses as volume steps click through, with distinctive boundary pulses at 0% and 100%. ### 5. Native Hardware AudioManager Integration Directly controls Android's native `AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC`, respecting your hardware's step boundaries and suppressing the intrusive system default volume dialog. --- ## 🛡️ Privacy & Engineering Architecture Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, Gesture Volume adheres to strict security, privacy, and battery guidelines: | Capability / Metric | Gesture Volume Specification | | :--- | :--- | | **Internet Permission** | ❌ None. `android.permission.INTERNET` is completely absent from the manifest. 100% offline. | | **Screen Content Scraping** | ❌ None. `canRetrieveWindowContent = false` is hardcoded. Zero keystroke, text, or screen monitoring. | | **Idle Battery Tax** | 🔋 **0.00%**. Event-driven architecture with zero background polling loops and zero wakelocks. | | **Binary Size** | 🪶 **~1.1 MB**. Stripped and optimized with R8 / ProGuard. | | **System Compatibility** | 📲 Android 8.0 (API 26) through Android 15 (API 35). Samsung, Pixel, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Motorola. | --- ## 🛠️ Quick 2-Minute Setup Guide Getting started after purchasing the Gumroad release is effortless: 1. **Download the APK:** Download `GestureVolume-v1.0.1.apk` directly from your Gumroad receipt. 2. **Allow Installation:** Tap the APK to install. If your browser or file manager asks, toggle *"Allow from this source"*. 3. **Grant Accessibility Overlay:** Open Gesture Volume and tap **"Enable Service"**. Toggle the Accessibility switch to ON. This allows the isolated edge handle to float above your applications without root or intrusive permissions. 4. **You're Done:** Test the slider in the built-in Sandbox, tweak your position in Settings, and enjoy frictionless volume control! --- ## ☕ Supporting Independent Software Building focused, lightweight, and ad-free utilities for Android is a labor of love.
